run_health_checks: run concurrent health checks on all LiteLLM proxy models and report their status
fetch_models: fetch all available models from the LiteLLM proxy API using the v1/models endpoint
load_models_from_yaml: load model configurations from a YAML config file with model names and modes
check_model_health: check health of a single model by sending a test chat or embedding request
print_results: print health check results in human-readable format or JSON output to stdout
